  "citazione": "If rejects rise on ALL valves at the same time and the inlet flow oscillates, the cause is almost always upstream (unstable supply from the feed pump), not in the filler: check the feed pump before working on the valves.",
  "confidenza": 0.7,
  "azione_raccomandata": "Check the feed pump and inlet flow stability. If the pump is unstable, schedule maintenance on the feed pump. Do not work on the filler valves yet. Monitor rejects; if they exceed 3%, stop production.",
